note: Hours, fees and rules as each track's own website gave them on the day checked. They change: the place page shows the date and links the source.

places.year: Membership $30 a month for one rider, $50 a month for a household of two or more riders
places.how: Members only: join on the track's site before you go. Ride days are listed for members.
rules: No flaggers on duty
Two spectators per rider
Full riding gear required
Riders under 18 need a waiver signed by a parent or guardian
No alcohol on the property
Idle speed only in the pits and parking
places.source_title: Bushnell MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Wednesday 1:00–7:30 pm (quads and dirt bikes); Saturday and Sunday 10 am–4 pm. Private sessions outside these hours by phone.
places.day: Rider $50; spectator $15. Wednesdays: dirt bikes $50, quads $100.
rules: No rentals: bring your own bike and gear
A minor riding without a parent needs the track's release form signed and notarized
places.source_title: Mesa Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: 9 am–5 pm on its five open days a week (closed two days); riding is by booked training only.
places.how: Training places are limited; contact the facility to book.
places.source_title: Moto Sandbox MX Training Facility: the track's own website

places.hours: By booking only.
places.day: Private ride session: $50 per bike for two hours, for a group of up to six, paid on arrival.
places.how: Book through the track's site. Text before calling.
rules: Ride sessions need your own bike and gear
Two waivers must be signed before riding
Lessons can include a rental bike and gear
places.source_title: Harold Motor Sports: the track's own website

places.how: A members' club: apply for membership on the park's site.
rules: Dirt bikes have their own trail area with a staging area, restrooms, camping and a wash area
places.source_title: Florida Cracker Ranch: the track's own website

places.hours: Open most weekends, weather permitting. The track's calendar shows the next open day.
places.source_title: Lane Farm MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Ride days and races through the year: check the track's schedule for dates. Members can ride seven days a week except race weekends.
places.day: Practice $30 per rider per day. Gate fee $15 on race weekends only (age 5 and under free). Race entry $30 a class ($45 pro).
places.year: Membership $700 a year for one rider, $1,000 for an immediate family (camping not included).
rules: Pit vehicles $15 and only on the pit track
Camping hookup $50 a day with water and power, no sewer
places.source_title: TenMile MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Open riding, training and stay-and-ride are booked through the facility's site.
places.how: No spectator fee: friends and family watch free.
rules: 10 mph everywhere off the tracks and trails
Helmet on any time you are on a bike
Under 18: waiver signed by both parents and a parent present, or a notarized guardianship letter
No firearms
places.source_title: Victory Training Facility: the track's own website

places.how: Ride tickets, campsites and rental campers are booked on the track's site.
places.source_title: Southern Training Facility & Raceway: the track's own website

places.hours: Wednesday and Thursday 11 am–6 pm. Saturday and Sunday: gates 8:30 am, riding from 9 am, main track closes 4 pm, the rest of the park 6 pm.
places.source_title: 74MX at the RKC: the track's own website

places.hours: Open daily 10 am–5 pm. Closed some days for enduro events.
places.day: Gate $5 for everyone, riders or not. Ride fee $35, or $15 for age 8 and under.
rules: Overnight camping $10 a person; RV hookups $50 with water and power
Rental motorcycles available
places.source_title: Battery Park Offroad: the track's own website

places.hours: Park hours 9 am–5 pm, open every day. Tuesdays are members only.
places.day: Day passes, weekend passes and memberships are sold at the office when you check in.
rules: Primitive and RV camping; generators allowed
places.source_title: Brushy Mountain Motor Sports Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open every weekend for open practice, 10 am–6 pm on open days; some weekdays when the days are longer.
places.how: Groups can call at least a day ahead to ride on a closed day.
places.address: 10632 Green Swamp Rd S, Bolton, NC 28423
places.source_title: County Line MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Saturday night racing: gates 2 pm, practice 3 pm, racing 5 pm. Saturdays with no race: practice 5–9 pm. Thursday night practice: 50cc 4–6 pm, all other classes 6–10 pm. Sunday day practice on the extended track 9 am–2 pm on calendar dates. MX school Saturdays 9 am–12:30 pm.
places.day: Gate $15 for riders and spectators. Practice $20 (Sunday extended track $30). Race entry $30 a class. Saturday MX school $40 with no gate fee.
rules: Under 5 free at the gate if not racing
No membership needed for the Saturday school
places.source_title: Dade City Motocross: the track's own website

places.hours: Weekly practice Saturday 1–4:30 pm through the winter. Race days on the series schedule.
places.day: Practice $15 for 50cc, $20 for bigger bikes; spectators $5. Race days: adults $10, ages 6–12 $5.
places.source_title: Daniels Ridge MX: the track's own website

places.hours: January to April: organized public practice on Saturdays only; gates 7 am, registration 9 am. A practice week in mid November and some December weekends are announced by email.
places.day: Public practice $50 per rider; $40 for Florida and Georgia residents; $35 each for a family of four or more; $30 military; mini track $25.
places.season: Winter season: mid November to April.
rules: Wristband must be worn on the wrist
Check the track's social pages for weather changes before the weekend
places.source_title: Sunshine State MX Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open practice on select weekends only: if the schedule does not show the track open, it is not open. Practice days: gates 7 am. Race days: gates 6 am, racing 9 am.
places.how: Call or text the track with questions.
places.source_title: Echeconnee MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Open now and then for practice; dates are posted on the track's Facebook page.
places.year: Individual, family and minor memberships are sold on the track's site; members pay no extra entry on scheduled open-practice days.
places.how: Members scan in at an automated gate with a digital membership card.
rules: Riders under 18 need a Minor Rider membership bought and waiver signed by a parent or guardian
places.source_title: Fast Farms MX Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Riding seven days a week 9:00 am–5:30 pm; store and office 9 am–5 pm. Closed only Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.
rules: The Pee-Wee track is for small riders on small bikes only
places.source_title: Highland Park Off-Road Resort: the track's own website

places.hours: Office hours: Thursday 8 am–5 pm, Friday and Saturday 8 am–8 pm, Sunday 8 am–5 pm.
rules: Helmet, closed-toe shoes and protective gear required for riders and passengers
No open containers in off-road vehicles
Quiet zone near the church every Sunday 10 am–12:30 pm Central
places.source_title: Indian Mountain ATV Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open daily, weather permitting, 10 am–5 pm (4 pm in winter). Call first to make sure the track is open.
places.day: Open practice is sold by the day, seven days a week.
places.source_title: JWTF MX (Jimmy Weinert Training Facility): the track's own website

places.day: Ride fee $30 (child $20) plus a $10 day pass if you are not a yearly member. Side-by-side $40 with one passenger.
places.year: Yearly membership $30, good January 1 to December 31.
places.how: Everyone who rides must be a member for the day or the year; age 6 and under ride free but still need the membership.
rules: Not every track is open every day
Quiet hours 9 pm–8 am
Fees can differ for races and special events
places.source_title: The Master's Motoplex: the track's own website

places.hours: No fixed weekly schedule: race and practice dates are posted on the track's site and Facebook page.
places.source_title: McLarty MX Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Monday to Friday 8 am–5 pm; closed Saturday and Sunday.
places.how: A training facility: riding is through its camps and programs.
places.source_title: Millsaps Training Facility: the track's own website

places.hours: Thursday 9 am–2 pm. Saturday 8 am–4 pm and Sunday 8 am–6 pm: minis from 8, beginner, novice and vet novice from 9, advanced from 10. Closed Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday.
places.source_title: North Florida Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Saturday and Sunday 10 am–4 pm; Wednesday and Thursday 10 am to dark.
places.source_title: Orlando MX Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open 24 hours a day.
places.day: $20 per person per day. RV hookup $40 a night.
places.year: Yearly $325 for one rider, $500 for a family of four ($100 for each additional family member).
rules: No night riding without a real headlight
places.source_title: Outback MotorSports Complex: the track's own website

places.hours: Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday 9 am–2 pm on all tracks; gates open 7:30 am. Closed Wednesday and Thursday for track prep.
rules: Camping only in the marked camping areas
places.source_title: Pala Raceway (formerly Fox Raceway at Pala): the track's own website

places.hours: Friday, Saturday and Sunday 9 am–6 pm (9 am–5 pm in winter). Closes for bad weather.
places.source_title: The Ridge - Alabama Outdoor Adventure Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open every day, 9 am to dark. Races are on Sundays with practice the Saturday before.
places.day: $25 per person per day, plus $10 for each extra rider sharing a bike. Pee-wee track $10 a bike.
rules: Camping $30 for 24 hours with power and water
places.source_title: Riverside Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open practice days run 9 am–3 pm with sign-up at 8 am; each hour is split into 12-minute groups by class.
rules: Bring your racing membership card
places.source_title: The Wick 338 (Southwick): the track's own website

places.hours: Summer hours: Wednesday and Friday 5–9 pm, weather permitting. Check the track's Instagram or Facebook before you leave.
places.source_title: Top Gun MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Opens Thursday 8 am and closes Sunday 5 pm. Closed Monday to Wednesday.
places.source_title: TOP Trails OHV Park: the track's own website

places.hours: The trail system is open 24 hours a day, every day of the year.
places.source_title: Windrock Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Wednesday 2 pm to dusk; Saturday and Sunday 10 am–4 pm.
places.day: Rider $50 on weekends, $60 on Wednesdays. Spectators $15; children under 10 watch free.
rules: Rental bike with full gear available: $250 for two hours
Private training available
places.source_title: Miami Motocross Park: the track's own website

places.hours: Open every Wednesday afternoon, 4:30 pm to dark.
places.source_title: NXT LVL 101: the track's own website

places.hours: Training facility hours Monday to Friday 9 am–5 pm; closed Saturday and Sunday.
places.how: No open practice at this time: riding is through the training programs.
places.source_title: South of the Border Motocross: the track's own website

places.how: A training facility: riders who are not in its programs can only ride on the few open-practice weekends it announces on Instagram and Facebook.
places.source_title: The Shoals MX: the track's own website

places.hours: Open practice 10 am–4 pm on scheduled days; the track posts each month's dates.
rules: 72 RV sites, 24 with full hookups
places.source_title: Waldo MX & Event Grounds: the track's own website

places.hours: The weekly practice schedule is posted on the track's social pages.
places.day: Practice $30 on the main track, $10 on the pee-wee track.
places.source_title: Windy Hill Motocross: the track's own website

places.hours: Track days are posted on the shop's social pages at least a day ahead.
places.address: 1641 S. Les Franklin Rd, Jamestown, TN 38556
places.source_title: R3 Motoworx: the track's own website
